svg.title: DS Pick prompt system architecture diagram
svg.desc: Three-layer diagram showing compile-time constants, runtime injection, and volatile boundary, with sub-agent system and KV cache annotation on the right.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about base.md and what it contains')
sendPrompt('How does the personality overlay work in DS Pick?')
sendPrompt('What are the differences between agent, plan, and yolo modes?')
sendPrompt('What are the three approval policies in DS Pick?')
sendPrompt('What is the compact.md handoff template used for?')
sendPrompt('When is write_office_guide injected into the prompt?')
sendPrompt('What does subagent_output_format define?')

svg.text: runtime injection — workspace-static (KV cache: hit when workspace unchanged)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does load_project_context_with_parents work?')
sendPrompt('What fields does the environment block contain?')
sendPrompt('How does pick-rules.md get injected into the prompt?')
sendPrompt('How does the user memory block work in the prompt system?')
sendPrompt('How does the skills catalog get loaded into context?')
sendPrompt('What is the context management block in the prompt?')
sendPrompt('How does the automatic LSP diagnostics injection work after edits?')
sendPrompt('How does the DEEPSEEK_CLIENT_SURFACE env var work?')

svg.text: volatile boundary — KV cache BUSTS on every /compact

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does handoff.md contain and when is it written?')
sendPrompt('What is the working set and where is it injected?')
sendPrompt('What does system_prompt_for_mode_with_context_skills_session_and_approval do?')
sendPrompt('How does Engine refresh_system_prompt work in the turn loop?')
sendPrompt('How does the turn loop assemble the API request each turn?')

svg.text: sub-agent system — each child gets independent Engine + system prompt

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Explore sub-agent differ from the General sub-agent?')
sendPrompt('What tools does the Implementer sub-agent have access to?')
sendPrompt('How does the Reviewer sub-agent work in the CRAFT flow?')
sendPrompt('How does the Auditor sub-agent verify findings?')
sendPrompt('What are the Verifier and General sub-agent types used for?')
sendPrompt('What is the General sub-agent type used for?')

svg.text: max 3 cycles → escalate to user; Auditor mandatory for HIGH findings
proposed: TaskType layer — controls what gets injected per session

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What would the Chat TaskType inject into the prompt?')
sendPrompt('What would the Office TaskType inject into the prompt?')
sendPrompt('What does the Code TaskType inject — the full base.md?')
sendPrompt('What tools would Architecture TaskType block?')
sendPrompt('How would the auto TaskType detection work with keyword rules?')
